segments.he:
(גָאט הָאט לִיעֶבּ אַ גִיפְּרֶעגִילְטְן מֶענְטְשְׁן).
תקנו
(קיג) עַלמַה שֶּׁסִּפְּרוּ לְפָנָיו מִגָּדוֹל אֶחָד שֶׁלָּמַד מֵאָה וְתִשְׁעָה-עָשָׂר
segments.en: (110.) Once when I told him about a Chassid from Amsterdam who was famous in Brody — who traveled to the Land of Israel and I had seen him in the holy community of Kremenitz on his return from the Land of Israel. And I told him that I heard from him that he said he had already killed the evil inclination. He replied to me in a tone of rebuke: "What need is there to say he killed the evil inclination — since the aforementioned Chassid fasted much?" For the aforementioned Chassid fasted very greatly.
